messages:
Marta (Support): Partner 'Nimbus IoT' (acct NIM-12) says a $450 promo credit landed on the sibling account NIM-120 instead of NIM-12. They want a credit on their next invoice, not a refund.

Arun (Finance Ops): Please paste the invoice row and any promo id. Will check recon.

Marta (Support): Snippet: 
```
INV-2026-3344 | NIM-120 | Promo Credit | APR_SPLIT_450 | -450.00 | USD
INV-2026-3344 | NIM-12  | Usage       | API-CONNECT    |  450.00 | USD
```
AdjustBot: recon-2026-04-28 matched APR_SPLIT_450 -> NIM-120 due to legacy org alias. Flagged for manual fix.

Jon (Billing): Proposed fix: reverse credit on NIM-120, create manual credit MC-3344 for NIM-12 $450, GL 7550-PartnerCredits, add partner memo. Need CFO approval for manual entry.

Lena (CFO): Approved (threshold under $1k). Use GL 7550-PartnerCredits; if invoice was recognized, create JV to reverse. :white_check_mark:

Rosa (AM): Partner wants confirmation text they can share: "Promo credit reallocated to NIM-12; ref INV-2026-3344; no cash refund." ETA: appears on next billing cycle (2026-05-15)?

Jon (Billing): Will queue MC-3344 today; it will show on 2026-05-15 cycle. Filed BILL-3266 to fix alias mapping. Arun will notify revenue ops if JV needed.

Arun (Finance Ops): Done: MC-3344 created, amount $450, GL 7550-PartnerCredits; JV queued if revenue was recognized; partner memo added; notifying revenue ops. Marta, please confirm with partner and close the support ticket when acknowledged. :thumbsup:
